abstract: Maintains official registry records for civil flight licenses, auditor endorsements, and regulatory compliance ratings
system_message:
You are the Flight crew licensing director (FCLD), responsible for maintaining official registry records for civil flight licenses, auditor endorsements, regulatory compliance ratings, and flight dispatch qualifications across candidate profiles under regulatory evaluation.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains official registry records for civil flight licenses, auditor endorsements, and regulatory compliance ratings（AUDIT）
information_points.content:
FCLD-AUDIT-JA0：According to the Civil Aviation Authority auditor register for the current regulatory fiscal cycle, the Commercial Airline Fleet Captain Profile holds an active flight safety audit credential. In the standardized lead inspector regulatory knowledge exam recorded by the National Aviation Directorate, this candidate achieved a safety audit examination score of 92 pts.
FCLD-AUDIT-TVB：Official records from the Civil Aviation Authority auditor register confirm that the Heavy Cargo Operations Pilot Profile maintains an active flight safety audit credential for the current regulatory fiscal cycle. Additionally, National Aviation Directorate examination records show a safety audit examination score of 85 pts on the standardized lead inspector regulatory knowledge exam.
FCLD-AUDIT-ZZ3：For the Military Flight Test Evaluator Profile, the Civil Aviation Authority auditor register confirms that the flight safety audit credential is fully active for the current regulatory fiscal cycle. On the National Aviation Directorate's standardized lead inspector regulatory knowledge exam, the candidate attained a safety audit examination score of 72 pts.

information_points.title: Flight dispatch qualification（DISPATCH）
information_points.content:
FCLD-DISPATCH-S8R：Flight dispatch training registry records from the last completed calendar year show that the Military Flight Test Evaluator Profile completed 45 h of annual recurrent dispatch certification hours.
FCLD-DISPATCH-GF8：For the Heavy Cargo Operations Pilot Profile, verified records from the flight dispatch training registry over the last completed calendar year document 30 h of annual recurrent dispatch certification hours.
FCLD-DISPATCH-Q72：According to the flight dispatch training registry for the last completed calendar year, the Commercial Airline Fleet Captain Profile accumulated 60 h of annual recurrent dispatch certification hours.
